assessment.full125m: Fresh default-profile execution measures 0.6267824375 seconds versus 0.643116208 for retained secured execution and 0.9726336045 for the authenticated tuned legacy direct-I/O binary. It is faster in all 12 paired rounds against each control in this batch.
assessment.footprint: Peak RSS at 125M is 287293440 bytes for fresh streaming, 506511360 for retained secured and 178782208 for tuned legacy in this batch. Executables are 7063168, 6842992 and 3159168 bytes respectively. The approximately 200 MB/3.16 MB footprint target remains unmet.
assessment.interpretation: No additional runtime optimization was implemented between v1144 and v1145. The same effective opt-level-3/ThinLTO configuration now comes from the generated default, with fresh original/decoded artifacts. The 0.6268 versus earlier 0.6327-second result is a new batch observation, not an extra optimization benefit. The earlier approximately 0.639-second secured baseline remains valid historical evidence. This three-implementation comparison is not an isolated capability-overhead measurement or general language ranking; qualification does not authorize readiness or merge.

hardware_provenance: Established same-M1 machine context from the prior matched batches. The v1145 observer pins binaries, inputs, policy and idle checks; it does not record a new hardware probe.

implementation.streaming: One admitted CLI text observation feeds generated Mech scanner continuations through bounded UTF-8 line windows. Proven dead prefixes and consumed final-join chunks are released. EOF admits genuine full count/shape and original producer/length semantics before saved body failures. Same capability/provider/transaction authority and cumulative finite ledger; no Rust workload scanner.
implementation.descriptor_preparation: Derive the complete line-retention frontier inventory once during descriptor preparation and share that same freshly derived inventory with prefix layout and typed-IR identity hashing. Preserve unsupported/multiple-frontier handling, complete identity serialization, capture eligibility, all resource limits and work debits.
implementation.packaging: Generated normal release profile uses ThinLTO, opt-level 3 and symbol stripping with unchanged default unwind/codegen units. No CLI/profile environment override. The Mech source is compiled through the maintained Cranelift Object route; ThinLTO optimizes linked Rust host/libraries, not the already-native Mech Object.
retained_optimizations: Hoist only invocation-stable prefix/EOF/availability facts into generated entry SSA values; preserve mutable local/work loads and all semantic guards.

Cache exact full-chunk payload totals in immutable offset backing and sum chunks once per window, retaining ordinary cell inspection at partial edges. Ownership, reservations and cumulative charges remain unchanged.
Count line separators with bounded narrow partial sums before widening; preserve ordinary text/lines and chunk framing semantics for arbitrary input.
Reduce ASCII high bits and carriage-return masks independently, combining them only after scanning; preserve Unicode and CRLF semantics without an owner cache, allocation or changed work debit.
retained_review_corrections: Keep returned forward ranges open until their real endpoint is available, cap the live lower bound to the delivered extent, and preserve ordinary full-EOF errors and late source-failure priority.
Require every deferred count comparison to use the proved current row index; unproved lookahead or unrelated expressions select the existing snapshot strategy before acquisition.
Reject zero-valued live retention seed fields so unsupported seeds select the existing snapshot strategy instead of creating an invalid capture frontier.
implementation.identity_and_accounting: Fresh source compilation supplies its actual new nominal revision from the generated manifest. At both sizes the fresh complete report equals v1144 with only that known revision changed. Every repeated fresh/decoded execution must match this full report exactly, including work counters, bounded-lines storage, one observation/effect and the unchanged finite policy. No counter normalization or security relaxation.

method.timing: 12 serial rounds per size, all six orders twice; monotonic spawn-to-exit wall time with descriptors opened before timing. Includes startup and complete execution, including one secured round and report publication for secured variants. Warmups and hashing outside timing.
method.memory: 3 separate macOS time -l RSS runs per variant/size; not used as timing samples.
method.policy: Fresh default and retained secured use the exact finite launch. Legacy direct I/O is an explicitly unsecured historical control; it does not emit a security report.
method.identity: Fresh source compilation has a new actual nominal revision. method.interference: The observer checks for active compilers, relevant tests, benchmarks and profilers before and after every process and verifies all immutable pins before/after the batch.
